notes.text: Both stored Davidson Eruvin29a scalars explicitly have Rav Menashya bar Shegovli, supporting the root Rav expansion for this occurrence. The source abbreviation remains recorded as such; no rank is inferred from supposed chronology, and Shegovli remains untitled.
